purpose: SQLite transaction boundary for M452 LP gain → Fire Princess plans, persisting both team LP totals, both idempotency ledgers and the TagDuel session revision in one transaction.
contract: Checks expected revision and exact before-LP snapshot.
Persists both shared team LP totals and both source/Fire Princess event ledgers in one SQLite transaction.
Updates one session revision only after all validations pass.
Fully committed retries are idempotent even with the original stale revision.
Rejects partial ledgers, stale snapshots, stale revisions, malformed plans and finished sessions.
Validates the resulting TagDuel state and preserves physical inventory.

groups: atomic LP tuple + two-ledger + revision commit
finished session rejection and no-write guarantee

limitations: The module is not yet called by tagStore/duelEngineCurrent; central resolver integration remains blocked by M61 handoff.
Tests use a disposable SQLite database; no production session, player profile or inventory is touched.
No live Discord gateway, merge or deployment is performed.
